gloss: to scoop up; to pump out; to draw (water)

definitions.gloss: to scoop up; to pump out; to draw (water)
definitions.explanation: to physically remove liquid by scooping or pumping it out of a container or pit

definitions.gloss: to grasp; to understand; to read (someone's feelings)
definitions.explanation: to perceive and understand someone's unexpressed feelings, intentions, or the deeper meaning behind their words

examples.english: To draw water from a well.

examples.english: I asked a contractor to pump out the septic tank.

examples.english: To understand the other person's feelings.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{汲|く}む→汲む：02281_kumu⟧ (to scoop, to draw water) and ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). The physical image of drawing out liquid extends beautifully to the act of drawing out someone's unspoken feelings or meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{取|と}る: to understand someone's feelings
- ⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{取|と}る: to grasp someone's intention
- ⟦{行間|ぎょうかん}→行間：07324_gyoukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{取|と}る: to read between the lines
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{取|と}る: to listen to and absorb people's views

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{察|さっ}する→察する：08053_sassuru⟧: to sense or surmise; more intuitive and instantaneous than {汲|く}み{取|と}る
- ⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to read and understand; can refer to both literal reading (data, text) and figurative understanding
- ⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧: to understand; neutral and general, lacking the empathetic nuance of {汲|く}み{取|と}る
